context: Sunday morning at home. Yumiko is trying to take a family photo for the holiday card. Hina is unwilling; Ryosuke is patient.
purpose: three-speaker domestic comedy — small parental negotiation with a kid

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ひな、こっち向いて。一枚だけ、お願い。
lines.en: Hina — face this way. Just one photo, please.
lines.style: Gentle, patient request. Camera already in hand—slight lift in the voice as she positions it. Warm, not hurried.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: えー、もう撮ったでしょ。
lines.en: Ugh, come on — you already took one.
lines.style: Full eight-year-old protest, half-laughing and winding up. Voice bright with exasperation but not unkind. Eyes flicking between her parents.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ひな、本当に、最後の一枚だけ。
lines.en: Hina — truly, just the very last one.
lines.style: Soft dad-mediator voice. Light, genuine warmth beneath the gentle insistence. Almost conspiratorial—he's on her side, gently steering.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Skeptical little voice, testing them. Small pause before speaking. Head tilting slightly, eyes narrowing with mock suspicion but ready to be convinced.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本当に最後。約束。一緒に、はい。
lines.en: Really the last. I promise. Come on — say cheese.
lines.style: Firm-warm closer. Camera lifted with finality. A small solemn promise in her voice, then a shift toward playfulness to seal the deal.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A real, bright grin floods the voice—the moment won. Small and genuine, relief and delight mixed. The shoot is saved.
